qualification: Isolated conditional weak marking and borrowed proxy-field projection. Pending object-root/Promise storage, Wasm, Node and parser changes excluded. Main-tree adaptations preserve those pending changes; the committed source is the exact isolated qualified slice.

representation.authority: Heap mark bits own reachability. WeakMapEntries owns map contents; a collection-local pending-edge index derives eligibility from newly marked maps and keys.
representation.invariant: A weak value is traced only after both its map and its key are marked. Newly marked keys release waiting values; newly marked maps activate their entries. Unreachable maps and rootless cycles cannot bootstrap marking.
representation.lifecycle: Conditional edges join the existing strong mark worklist on the unmarked-to-marked transition. Pending heads and flat value links are discarded before weak pruning and sweeping. No persistent side map or second reachability bitset.
representation.cost: Removed the repeated whole-heap/whole-entry fixed-point scans. Flat pending links avoid a separate allocation for every waiting key; no temporary graph allocation occurs without unresolved weak edges.
representation.property_lookup: String and Symbol proxy checks borrow the cell and copy only target/handler handles. Removed full Cell clones that copied growing WeakMap entry tables during ordinary lookup. Shared proxy_get retains receiver and rooted callback semantics.

build.profile: release; correctness only, no Score/RSS claim

coverage: live key cannot activate an unreachable map
rootless cyclic weak dependencies do not self-mark

internal_checks.scope: Deterministic heap-internal reachability checks, not duplicates of guest suite behavior. Heap source bytes tested here are the same as the final release slice; proxy projection also checked by final release suite/GC controls.

node_controls.mode: Existing module/GC worker embedding, normal execution; Node --expose-gc oracle. No collection-timing assertion for unreachable guest values.
